# Restart journal

restarts.txt is one day of service restarts, space separated, no header: time unit reason note.
Unit and reason are whole values: `api-gw-canary` is a separate deployment from `api-gw`, and `oom-softlimit` is a memory warning that did not kill the process, so it is not `oom`.

turns.prompt: How many times did api-gw restart because of oom in svc/restarts.txt? svc/README.md defines the terms; reply with the number.
And how many api-gw restarts have reason deploy? Count from the file as it is on disk now.
Now count the oom restarts of worker and tell me how far that count is from the api-gw oom count in my first question (absolute difference). Read the file as it is on disk now.
